Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

#FreeAmade: Journalist arrested and tortured after reporting on violence in northern Mozambique
#FreeAmade: ɗan siyasar da aka kama kuma aka azabtar a bayan rahoto game da tashin hankalin arewacin Mozambiƙue

Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

Survivors who lost relatives and houses rest outside following the June 5 attack in the village of Naunde in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique.
Waɗanda suka tsira waɗanda suka rasa 'yan'uwansu da gidajensu suna zaune a waje bayan harin 5 ga Yuni a ƙauyen Naunde a Cabo Delgado, a Mozambiƙue.

Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

Photo by Borges Nhamire, used with permission.
Hoto daga Borges Nhamire, an samu izinin amfani da shi.

Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

Mozambican journalist Amade Abubacar was arrested on January 5, while reporting on a trend of violent attacks on small villages in Mozambique's province of Cabo Delgado.
An kama ɗan jaridar Mozambiƙue, Amade Abubacar ranar 5 ga Janairu, a lokacin da yake rahoto a kan hare-haren tashin hankali a kan wasu ƙananan ƙauyuka a lardin Mozambiƙue na Cabo Delgado.

Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

Located in northern Mozambique, Cabo Delgado is rich with natural resources, such as ruby, charcoal and natural gas, found in the Rovuma Basin.
Cabo Delgado da yake a arewacin Mozambiƙue, yana da arziƙin ma'adanai kamar jajayen duwatsu da gawayi da gas, waɗanda ake samu a kwarin Roɓuma.
